FAIL — independent QA and independent maintainer security verdict for PR #7 at head `ee560a3b4959b762f2294dd4c679b907760b8879`.

Reviewed [PR #7](https://github.com/nearfolk/paperclip/pull/7) against base `916c13501f80c7d1d659b89e4a06dc47366aa80f` and this ticket's repository-token, trusted-base, exact-head, sanitization, and fail-closed contract. The candidate is not eligible for activation. The inherited missing-App-key bootstrap failure is NOT the reason for this FAIL.

- **P1: security results are not reliably bound to the scanned head.** [check-pr-security.mjs lines 378–403](https://github.com/nearfolk/paperclip/blob/ee560a3b4959b762f2294dd4c679b907760b8879/.github/scripts/check-pr-security.mjs#L378) fetches current PR metadata and paginated files independently from mutable endpoints; the workflow supplies no expected event head/base to the scanner. The report copies `pr.head.sha`, without proving that the files came from that SHA. A deterministic mocked CLI execution returned clean files for head A and metadata for head B: the script posted `security-review: success` on B and exited 0. Pagination can also mix revisions. This is inherited behavior retained by the patch, but it fails the explicit exact-head contract. Fix: pass validated event head/base SHAs, collect a complete immutable diff for that pair, pin content reads to those SHAs, and reject stale/mismatched snapshots before reporting. Add adversarial tests for head movement and movement between file pages. Never execute candidate code to collect the diff.
- **P2: dependency API errors/timeouts silently pass.** [check-pr-dependencies.mjs lines 44–72](https://github.com/nearfolk/paperclip/blob/ee560a3b4959b762f2294dd4c679b907760b8879/.github/scripts/check-pr-dependencies.mjs#L44), invoked by the reviewed quality runner, catches every content-fetch/parse error and returns `{passed:true, informational:[]}`. Independent injected 403 and timeout fixtures both reproduced that result. This is also inherited, not a new regression; the broad fail-closed claim is not satisfied. Fix: distinguish an expected absent base manifest from authentication, rate-limit, transport, timeout, and malformed-content errors; propagate unexpected failures to the quality job and test them. Findings can remain informational while incomplete scans fail.

Verified positives and reproducible evidence:

- Extracted `.github` directly from the exact Git object; did not modify an implementation checkout. Independently ran `node --test .github/scripts/tests/*.test.mjs`: **126 passed, 0 failed**, Node v24.14.1. YAML parsing and `git diff --check` passed. Local Node 20 execution and a full application suite were not repeated; ordinary GitHub CI is reported separately below.
- Restricted `github.token` permissions are contents read, pull-requests write, checks write; checkout uses the event base SHA with `persist-credentials:false`; pinned actions and trusted local scripts execute, with PR content used only as API data. No upstream credential is needed by the revised workflow.
- Dependency Review, six quality/dependency checks, and all six security scanners remain. Check-mode output allows only fixed categories/counts, excludes matched content/paths/title, and retains neutral findings semantics. Security-report API failures and the watchdog now fail; neutral is not maintainer approval. Bot comment deduplication regression coverage passes.
- [QA evidence archive](/api/attachments/21624e79-0b51-4b94-81fa-915356c4d858/content): immutable scripts/tests, complete regression output, mocked reproduction, timestamped CI snapshot, and manifest. Extract and run `node adversarial-repro.mjs`; it uses only synthetic responses and credentials. Its exit 0 means the defects were reproduced, not that QA passed.

CI snapshot at review completion (PR OPEN; head/base unchanged; `behind_by:0`, ahead by 1; merge state UNSTABLE):

- [Ordinary PR run 45445425441](https://github.com/nearfolk/paperclip/actions/runs/45445425441): policy, Typecheck + Release Registry, all three general server shards, both general workspace groups, Build, all four serialized server shards, Canary Dry Run, e2e shard (2/2), and aggregate verify **passed**.
- **Pending:** e2e shard (1/2). Aggregate `e2e` is not yet reported because it depends on the shards. Neither is waived. No ordinary-CI failure was reported in this snapshot.
- Storybook visual regression **skipped** under its label/manual-only condition; this patch has no UI changes. No live `security-review` check exists yet, and no `branch-freshness` context is present. The Greptile 5/5 PR checklist item remains unchecked/unverified; no corresponding receipt was supplied.
- [Inherited review run 45445425164](https://github.com/nearfolk/paperclip/actions/runs/45445425164): failure confirmed specifically at `Generate commitperclip token`, missing `COMMITPERCLIP_KEY`. It runs old base code. I did not rerun it or request an App key. This is a bootstrap limitation, not candidate execution evidence.
- Required independent security review is delivered here as FAIL. Product/design/editorial review is not applicable to this six-file CI-only change. No GitHub reviews exist and no GitHub approval is required or submitted.

Activation path for CTO in [LIV-11629](/LIV/issues/LIV-11629):

1. Remediate the findings, identify the new immutable head, and return it to this same QA seat for fresh review and explicit disposition of this FAIL. The existing user authorization supports the bounded repository-owned authentication change; it does not permit activation of this failed candidate or bypass of ordinary CI.
2. Establish a fork-aware protected activation command before merging. The fork has no `merge:pr` script or `.github/workflows/ci.yml`; the liveslip.ai guard reads that workflow path and requires `branch-freshness`. It cannot honestly certify this fork's `.github/workflows/pr.yml` matrix and aggregate jobs as configured. The master protection API reports “Branch not protected.” Do not substitute a raw merge or treat absent controls as passing. Adapt/review the guard to the fork workflow/job inventory and fresh master comparison, preserving same-head independent verdicts, unretracted-FAIL/hold checks, distinct operator handoff, five-minute interval, and expected-head merge matching. This review child is intentionally done on verdict delivery; account explicitly for its lifecycle when wiring the operator handoff.
3. Only after corrected exact-head QA/security and all applicable ordinary gates pass, CTO may perform the authorized bounded base-workflow activation through that protected path. Preserve five full minutes from the qualifying verdict. After activation, create NEW PR events, verify repository-token permissions, quality-comment upsert, and security-review results for each new exact head; historical reruns are insufficient. Re-review updated safeguard PRs separately.

This child is done because its review deliverable is complete, not because the candidate passed. CTO owns remediation/activation; [LIV-11620](/LIV/issues/LIV-11620) remains open for deployed acceptance and measurements. No merge, deployment, GitHub approval, or browser automation was performed.

FAIL — independent QA and maintainer security verdict for PR #7 at exact head `c64e1cf3530a195940a7b19a3059be74a7eb519c`, against master `916c13501f80c7d1d659b89e4a06dc47366aa80f`.

Reviewed the immutable scanner/dependency contract and protected fork activation contract in this ticket, [implementation](/LIV/issues/LIV-11631), `doc/FORK-RELEASE.md`, and the liveslip.ai release runbook. The original scanner defects are repaired in the tested paths, but the new activation guard has three reproducible defects. This candidate is not eligible for activation. The [original FAIL](/LIV/issues/LIV-11630#comment-154795a9-79ab-40a7-94c1-bdfefb398979), comment `154795a9-79ab-40a7-94c1-bdfefb398979`, remains unretracted. No protected activation child was created.

- **P2 — cross-head FAIL history uses an incomplete verdict parser.** [fork-gate-policy.mjs:68](https://github.com/nearfolk/paperclip/blob/c64e1cf3530a195940a7b19a3059be74a7eb519c/scripts/fork-gate-policy.mjs#L68) recognizes only line-leading FAIL/changes requested. The inherited evaluator also recognizes `Security verdict: FAIL`. With a valid retraction of the original failure, an additional older-head `Security verdict: FAIL` on the declared history ticket is silently ignored and eligibility succeeds; changing only its format to line-leading FAIL correctly blocks. Use a shared complete verdict classifier and require the original author's explicit new-head retraction for every qualifying failure across heads/tickets. Add both formats and cross-head cases to regression coverage.
- **P2 — required team PASS edits can bypass freshness and the five-minute interval.** [fork-gate-policy.mjs:60](https://github.com/nearfolk/paperclip/blob/c64e1cf3530a195940a7b19a3059be74a7eb519c/scripts/fork-gate-policy.mjs#L60) validates team authors/head but uses only `createdAt`. A required security PASS created at 11:00 and edited to the reviewed candidate at 12:04:59 is accepted at 12:05:00. The primary QA PASS has an edited-comment rejection at line 55; required team receipts do not. Require fresh immutable comments for every required verdict, with five full minutes from the qualifying new receipt. The current empty team inventory does not exercise this branch; the claimed reusable guard contract requires it to be correct.
- **P2 — the real ticket chain cannot complete the documented operator handoff.** [fork-ticket-authority.mjs:507](https://github.com/nearfolk/paperclip/blob/c64e1cf3530a195940a7b19a3059be74a7eb519c/scripts/fork-ticket-authority.mjs#L507) misclassifies this ticket's factual sentence, `Previous head's 126-test/full-suite/CI results do not approve this head.`, as a release denial. Offline evaluation with the real ancestor histories and hypothetical valid reviewer retraction/PASS/handoff fails with `Ticket-scoped merge denial actor authority is unavailable at issue be1d1a33-4bb2-4ac1-be05-d51b31a0f741 description`. Rephrasing only that stale-evidence sentence in an offline control makes the isolated case pass. Preserve actual holds/denials while distinguishing stale-evidence statements, and regression-test the real ticket lifecycle. Do not obtain a routine board clearance or bypass the protected command to work around this parser defect. All simulated receipts remained offline; none were posted.

[Reproducible QA evidence archive](/api/attachments/ae40302f-a3b4-4084-bd89-bd291a0a4ef3/content), also registered as an artifact work product:

- Independent clean detached checkout at the exact candidate; implementation checkout untouched. `node --test .github/scripts/tests/*.test.mjs scripts/fork-*.test.mjs`: **226/226 PASS**. Product authority regressions applied to the adapted evaluator: **82/82 PASS**. Additional independent scanner suite: **20/20 PASS**. Node v24.14.1; clean Git status and diff check.
- `node --test guard-regressions.test.mjs` from the extracted archive: **three expected-behavior tests fail**, reproducing the three findings. Scanner and inherited authority reproducers run offline from the archive. Sources, logs, actual ticket-description fixture, CI snapshots and SHA-256 manifest are included.
- Immutable collection rejects head/base movement at all three metadata reads, uses no mutable file pages, handles **3,001 changed files plus attributes**, and executes no candidate diff driver. A real **33 MiB patch** exceeds the buffer bound and fails closed. Truncation, missing history and API failures reject. All six scanners, pinned content reads, final pair checks, fixed-category/count-only check reporting, and restricted ephemeral repository-token permissions remain.
- Dependency base/head 403, rate limit, transport, timeout and malformed data reject; existing-base/candidate 404 reject; typed new-manifest base 404 still reports added dependencies. Escaped path/query fixtures preserve the immutable ref.
- Mapping digest is `0abc4f154dd668ad30a359e0e740082a9c48750c2e95359e2230c1c504589443`; all 17 actual ordinary matrix/aggregate jobs are represented, with workflow digest, run/attempt provenance, immutable master comparison and final master recheck. Other focused checks cover missing/failed/skipped jobs, head/base movement, API failure, distinct CTO identity, reviewer-authored assignment, original FAIL retraction, 4:59 rejection and expected-head merge matching. The three findings prevent acceptance of the overall mapping/activation contract.

Validation and live state:

- Build and workspace typecheck PASS verified from author logs and new-head GitHub Build / Typecheck + Release Registry jobs. QA did not rerun the full application build locally. [Author final evidence](/api/attachments/b86559f8-f546-4720-9776-0e159ca445c7/content) confirms the full UTC local suite ended unsuccessfully: one workspace-runtime and two branch-containment tests failed in unchanged files, followed by missing Vitest preload/cwd errors; later phases did not complete. Root causes remain unestablished. No complete local-suite PASS or waiver.
- Final reads at approximately 17:49–17:50 UTC: PR OPEN, assigned head/base unchanged; immutable comparison `behind_by:0`, `ahead_by:2`. [Ordinary run 45450941619](https://github.com/nearfolk/paperclip/actions/runs/45450941619), attempt 1, now reports completed/success on this head. All 17 job conclusions report success, but the jobs endpoint still reports aggregate `e2e` as `in_progress` with conclusion `success`; therefore the final job-level snapshot is not consistently complete. The archived earlier snapshot records e2e pending. CTO must obtain a fresh internally consistent snapshot after remediation; this does not clear the code findings.
- [Inherited review run 45450918213](https://github.com/nearfolk/paperclip/actions/runs/45450918213) fails only at Generate commitperclip token, with the missing COMMITPERCLIP_KEY log. Checkout, Dependency Review and Node setup succeeded. The pinned old workflow digest and exact old master match the bounded exception. This inherited failure is not the reason for FAIL, and the exception cannot waive the findings or other gates.
- Conditional Storybook skip observed; no UI changes. No `branch-freshness` status or native `security-review` result is asserted. GitHub reviews are empty. Master protection API returns “Branch not protected”; GitHub merge has no atomic expected-base predicate. The documented local guard cannot be represented as server-enforced protection.

Independent maintainer security verdict: **FAIL**. Product/design/editorial reviews are not applicable to this CI/security-only change; no additional team verdict is needed for this scope. No GitHub approval, raw merge, deployment, credential procurement, old-job rerun, browser automation, agent pause, or product-repository release-control change was performed.

This review-deliverable child is done because its verdict and evidence are delivered, not because the candidate passed. CTO retains activation in [LIV-11629](/LIV/issues/LIV-11629); [LIV-11620](/LIV/issues/LIV-11620) remains open. A future PASS must create the separate open operator gate and reviewer-authored assignment; this completed FAIL ticket is never merge eligibility.

FAIL — independent QA and maintainer security verdict for [PR #7](https://github.com/nearfolk/paperclip/pull/7) at exact head `dcda5867f34362396c655e92dac804f464cd3275`, against master `916c13501f80c7d1d659b89e4a06dc47366aa80f`.

Reviewed this ticket's immutable scanner, dependency-failure, mapping, bootstrap and protected activation contracts; [implementation](/LIV/issues/LIV-11631); doc/FORK-RELEASE.md; and the liveslip.ai release runbook. The previous scanner defects and three previous guard reproducers pass, but two additional authority defects block this candidate.

- **P2 — negated and prospective statements qualify as explicit FAIL retractions.** [fork-ticket-authority.mjs:66](https://github.com/nearfolk/paperclip/blob/dcda5867f34362396c655e92dac804f464cd3275/scripts/fork-ticket-authority.mjs#L66) accepts nearby retraction/FAIL words; [fork-gate-policy.mjs:71](https://github.com/nearfolk/paperclip/blob/dcda5867f34362396c655e92dac804f464cd3275/scripts/fork-gate-policy.mjs#L71) uses that classification to clear history. In an otherwise valid offline handoff, replacing the original-author retraction with `I do not retract FAIL at comment original-fail for corrected head <candidate>.`, `I will retract FAIL ... after remediation is validated.`, or `A future retraction of FAIL ... is required.` still returns eligible. Require an affirmative, completed, unqualified original-author retraction receipt; reject negation, future/conditional language and instructions. Preserve exact comment/head binding.
- **P2 — explicit current-head merge denials are ignored.** [fork-ticket-authority.mjs:510](https://github.com/nearfolk/paperclip/blob/dcda5867f34362396c655e92dac804f464cd3275/scripts/fork-ticket-authority.mjs#L510) recognizes denial of approval/authorization but omits direct merge prohibitions. A later authenticated CEO comment `Do not merge PR #7 at exact head <candidate>` or `Must not merge PR #7 at exact head <candidate>` does not block on either the gate or an ancestor. Adding `approve or` makes the same case reject. Reproduced with minimal fixtures and the actual saved full ticket/ancestor chain plus an offline hypothetical valid handoff. Recognize direct merge/release prohibitions and ambiguous scope fail-closed while preserving factual stale-evidence and reviewer-only boundaries. No routine board clearance or raw merge is a workaround.

[Independent reproducible evidence archive](/api/attachments/00f328a9-fb38-4fd6-be2b-750e96e38d53/content), registered as an artifact work product:

- Clean isolated detached checkout; implementation checkout untouched. Node v24.14.1. `node --test .github/scripts/tests/*.test.mjs scripts/fork-*.test.mjs`: **244/244 PASS**; diff check and clean Git status pass.

- Dependency 403/rate-limit/transport/timeout/malformed responses reject; candidate and existing-base 404 reject; typed added-manifest base 404 still reports dependencies. URL escaping preserves the immutable ref.
- Mapping digest remains `0abc4f154dd668ad30a359e0e740082a9c48750c2e95359e2230c1c504589443`. All 17 actual ordinary matrix/aggregate jobs are mapped with workflow digest and run/attempt provenance. Tests cover missing/failed/skipped evidence, API errors, immutable master comparison, final master recheck, reviewer-authored distinct-CTO assignment, five minutes and expected-head merge matching. The findings prevent acceptance of the overall activation guard.

FAIL — independent QA and maintainer security verdict for [PR #7](https://github.com/nearfolk/paperclip/pull/7) at exact head `f69863b4371a2efd567a16454ab74167077f90c8`, against master `916c13501f80c7d1d659b89e4a06dc47366aa80f`.

Reviewed this assignment's immutable scanner, dependency, authority, mapping and bootstrap contracts; [implementation](/LIV/issues/LIV-11631); `doc/FORK-RELEASE.md`; and the liveslip.ai release runbook. The previous specific reproducers pass, but four authority defects still permit an ineligible handoff. This candidate is not eligible for activation.

- **P2 — explicit denial language is still incomplete.** [fork-ticket-authority.mjs:518](https://github.com/nearfolk/paperclip/blob/f69863b4371a2efd567a16454ab74167077f90c8/scripts/fork-ticket-authority.mjs#L518) ignores authenticated CEO statements `Merge is not authorized for PR #7 at exact head <candidate>.`, `Deployment is not authorized for exact head <candidate>.`, and `Do not under any circumstances merge PR #7 at exact head <candidate>.` Each permits eligibility on both gate and ancestor; the direct `Do not merge ...` control rejects. Recognize these negative/qualified prohibitions and fail closed on ambiguous release authority while preserving reviewer-only and factual-evidence exceptions.
- **P2 — an unrelated older SHA masks an adjacent current-head denial.** [fork-ticket-authority.mjs:835](https://github.com/nearfolk/paperclip/blob/f69863b4371a2efd567a16454ab74167077f90c8/scripts/fork-ticket-authority.mjs#L835) scopes the entire source by every SHA it contains. `Previous candidate was <older SHA>. Do not merge the current head of PR #7.` is discarded as an older-head directive, on either gate or ancestor. Bind scope to the actual directive/clause; an adjacent contextual SHA must not silently scope away a current or ambiguous denial. Add multi-sentence, multiple-head and unscoped-denial regressions.
- **P2 — required-review ticket descriptions are omitted from authority.** [fork-gate-policy.mjs:50](https://github.com/nearfolk/paperclip/blob/f69863b4371a2efd567a16454ab74167077f90c8/scripts/fork-gate-policy.mjs#L50) and its hold inventory at line 82 include required-ticket comments/ancestors but omit the ticket's own description. A required security ticket whose CEO-authored description says `Do not merge PR #7 at exact head <candidate>.` is accepted with an otherwise valid immutable security PASS. Include each declared required ticket's own description, actor, timestamp and source identity in both authority and hold evaluation. The current empty team inventory does not excuse this defect in the reusable guard contract.
- **P2 — hold clearances retain the non-affirmative/edited-receipt bypass.** [fork-ticket-authority.mjs:106](https://github.com/nearfolk/paperclip/blob/f69863b4371a2efd567a16454ab74167077f90c8/scripts/fork-ticket-authority.mjs#L106) and [fork-gate-policy.mjs:85](https://github.com/nearfolk/paperclip/blob/f69863b4371a2efd567a16454ab74167077f90c8/scripts/fork-gate-policy.mjs#L85) accept the hold author's `I will clear hold ... after remediation.`, `If remediation passes, I clear hold ...`, `I have not cleared hold ...`, an instruction, and a blockquote as actual clearance. An edited old clearance also qualifies using its original creation time despite an edit one second before evaluation. Require completed, affirmative, unqualified, immutable clearance receipts, exact parsed hold/head bindings and an authorized actor; fresh replacements must restart five full minutes. Apply that validation consistently in every clearance consumer.
